componentPlan.focusQuote: To amplify a segment of DNA using PCR, the sample is first heated so the DNA denatures, or separates into two pieces of single-stranded DNA.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Models the ordered heat denature and synthesis cycle in page order

componentPlan.focusQuote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.
componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: Checks recall of core facts about amplification and laboratory uses

overview.headline: PCR copies small DNA segments for lab and clinical study

keyPoints.point: PCR is a technique that amplifies small segments of DNA for analysis
keyPoints.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.

keyPoints.point: Amplified DNA supports fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses and diagnosis of genetic disorders
keyPoints.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders

keyPoints.point: Heated sample lets DNA denatures and separates into pieces for copying
keyPoints.quote: To amplify a segment of DNA using PCR, the sample is first heated so the DNA denatures, or separates into two pieces of single-stranded DNA.

keyPoints.point: Cycle of denaturing and synthesizing DNA is repeated many times to make exact copies
keyPoints.quote: The cycle of denaturing and synthesizing new DNA is repeated as many as 30 or 40 times

keyTerms.gloss: Technique that copies small segments of DNA for study
keyTerms.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.

keyTerms.gloss: Enzyme that builds new strands of DNA using original strands as templates
keyTerms.quote: Next, an enzyme called "Taq polymerase" synthesizes - builds - two new strands of DNA, using the original strands as templates.

keyTerms.gloss: Separates into pieces of single stranded DNA when heated
keyTerms.quote: To amplify a segment of DNA using PCR, the sample is first heated so the DNA denatures, or separates into two pieces of single-stranded DNA.

keyTerms.gloss: Machine called to direct automated cycling process
keyTerms.quote: It is directed by a machine called a thermocycler

keyTerms.gloss: Detection method using amplified DNA for laboratory identification
keyTerms.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders

analysis.pageCoverage: Explains what PCR is, why DNA amplification is needed, laboratory and clinical uses, and how denaturing, synthesis by Taq polymerase, and repeated cycling work
analysis.subject: biology
